title: Verified change candidate freshness gate
goal: Classify a verified non-applied change candidate as FRESH or STALE by exact base-SHA equality with canonical target HEAD.
laws: Exact 40-hex base and target identities are required.
Base mismatch is STALE_BASE even when a patch might technically apply.
Freshness classification does not mutate the candidate or repository.
Only FRESH may become apply-request eligible later.
